1	package cli
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"fmt"
6		"log/slog"
7		"os"
8		"os/signal"
9		"syscall"
10	
11		"github.com/nogo/wire/internal"
12		"github.com/nogo/wire/internal/config"
13		"github.com/nogo/wire/internal/gateway"
14		"github.com/nogo/wire/internal/monitor"
15		"github.com/nogo/wire/internal/process"
16		"github.com/nogo/wire/internal/vram"
17	)
18	
19	const usageText = `Usage: wire <command> [arguments]
20	
21	Commands:
22	  up                  Start the gateway (foreground)
23	  version             Print version and exit
24	
25	Environment:
26	  WIRE_CONFIG         Config file path (default: ~/.config/wire/config.yaml)
27	`
28	
29	// Run dispatches CLI commands from the given argument slice (os.Args[1:]).
30	// It returns an exit code suitable for os.Exit.
31	func Run(args []string) int {
32		if err := dispatch(args); err != nil {
33			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "wire:", err)
34			return 1
35		}
36		return 0
37	}
38	
39	func dispatch(args []string) error {
40		if len(args) == 0 {
41			fmt.Print(usageText)
42			return nil
43		}
44		switch args[0] {
45		case "help", "--help", "-h":
46			fmt.Print(usageText)
47			return nil
48		case "up":
49			return runUp()
50		case "version", "--version", "-v":
51			fmt.Printf("wire %s (%s) built %s\n", internal.Version, internal.Commit, internal.BuildDate)
52			return nil
53		default:
54			fmt.Print(usageText)
55			return fmt.Errorf("unknown command: %q", args[0])
56		}
57	}
58	
59	func runUp() error {
60		cfg, err := config.Load()
61		if err != nil {
62			return fmt.Errorf("loading config: %w", err)
63		}
64	
65		// bgCtx drives the process manager; cancelled only after gateway drains.
66		bgCtx, bgCancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
67		defer bgCancel()
68	
69		// shutCtx is cancelled by SIGTERM/SIGINT.
70		shutCtx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(bgCtx, syscall.SIGTERM, syscall.SIGINT)
71		defer stop()
72	
73		// 2. VRAM tracker init (GPU auto-detect, HF cache scan).
74		backend := detectGPUBackend(cfg)
75		tracker := vram.New(backend, vram.NewHFCache(cfg.HFCacheDir))
76		gpus := tracker.Discover()
77		tracker.HFCache().Scan()
78		tracker.Start()
79		defer tracker.Stop()
80	
81		// 3. Process manager init.
82		mgr := process.New(cfg, slog.Default())
83		if err := mgr.Start(bgCtx); err != nil {
84			return fmt.Errorf("starting process manager: %w", err)
85		}
86	
87		// Create remote tracker if any model references a provider.
88		var remote *monitor.RemoteTracker
89		for _, p := range cfg.Models {
90			if p.IsRemote() {
91				remote = monitor.NewRemoteTracker()
92				break
93			}
94		}
95	
96		// Create model discovery for providers that have list_models enabled.
97		var discovery *monitor.ModelDiscovery
98		if len(cfg.Providers) > 0 {
99			var endpoints []monitor.ProviderEndpoint
100			for name, p := range cfg.Providers {
101				if p.ShouldListModels() {
102					endpoints = append(endpoints, monitor.ProviderEndpoint{
103						Name:    name,
104						BaseURL: p.BaseURL,
105						APIKey:  p.APIKey,
106					})
107				}
108			}
109			if len(endpoints) > 0 {
110				discovery = monitor.NewModelDiscovery(endpoints, slog.Default())
111				discovery.Start()
112				defer discovery.Stop()
113			}
114		}
115	
116		// 4. Hub init (subscribes to VRAM tracker for GPU state).
117		var hub *monitor.Hub
118		if cfg.Monitor {
119			hub = monitor.NewHub(slog.Default(), mgr.Events(), mgr.Snapshot, remote, discovery, tracker.GPUStateCh())
120		}
121	
122		// 5. Gateway init (uses VRAM tracker + queue).
123		gw := gateway.New(cfg, mgr, hub, remote, discovery, slog.Default())
124	
125		if hub != nil {
126			hub.SetModelProvider(func() []monitor.ModelInfo {
127				return gw.Models()
128			})
129			hub.Start()
130			defer hub.Stop()
131		}
132	
133		// 6. Warmup models submitted through gateway's admission path.
134		// (Warmup via gateway is deferred to a follow-up WU.)
135	
136		gwErrCh := make(chan error, 1)
137		go func() { gwErrCh <- gw.ListenAndServe(shutCtx) }()
138	
139		var reloadCh <-chan *config.Config
140		if ch, err := config.Watch(bgCtx, slog.Default()); err != nil {
141			slog.Warn("config watcher unavailable", "err", err)
142		} else {
143			reloadCh = ch
144		}
145	
146		slog.Info("wire ready", "listen", cfg.Listen, "version", internal.Version, "commit", internal.Commit, "gpus", len(gpus))
147	
148		for {
149			select {
150			case err := <-gwErrCh:
151				bgCancel()
152				_ = mgr.Stop()
153				if err != nil {
154					return fmt.Errorf("gateway error: %w", err)
155				}
156				return nil
157	
158			case <-shutCtx.Done():
159				if cause := context.Cause(shutCtx); cause != nil {
160					slog.Info("shutting down", "cause", cause)
161				}
162				stop()
163				if err := <-gwErrCh; err != nil {
164					slog.Error("gateway shutdown error", "error", err)
165				}
166				bgCancel()
167				return mgr.Stop()
168	
169			case newCfg, ok := <-reloadCh:
170				if !ok || newCfg == nil {
171					reloadCh = nil
172					continue
173				}
174				if newCfg.Listen != cfg.Listen {
175					slog.Warn("listen address change requires restart")
176				}
177				if newCfg.Monitor != cfg.Monitor {
178					slog.Warn("monitor setting change requires restart")
179				}
180				slog.Info("config reloaded")
181				mgr.Reload(newCfg)
182				gw.UpdateConfig(newCfg)
183				cfg = newCfg
184			}
185		}
186	}
187	
188	// detectGPUBackend returns the appropriate vram.Backend following the
189	// auto-detection chain: AMD sysfs → noop (CPU-only).
190	func detectGPUBackend(_ *config.Config) vram.Backend {
191		sysfs := vram.NewSysfsBackend()
192		if gpus := sysfs.Discover(); len(gpus) > 0 {
193			return sysfs
194		}
195		return vram.NoopBackend{}
196	}
